description: This file provides utilities for uploading files to OneDrive and SharePoint, creating sharing links, resolving chat IDs, and retrieving chat members within the context of MS Teams integration.

methods.name: uploadToOneDrive
methods.description: Uploads a file to the user's OneDrive root folder, using the simple upload endpoint for files up to 4MB.

methods.name: createSharingLink
methods.description: Creates a sharing link for a specified OneDrive item, with scope either 'organization' or 'anonymous'.

methods.name: uploadAndShareOneDrive
methods.description: Uploads a file to OneDrive and creates a sharing link, returning item details and share URL.

methods.name: uploadToSharePoint
methods.description: Uploads a file to a SharePoint site, used for group chats and channels.

methods.name: getDriveItemProperties
methods.description: Retrieves eTag and webDavUrl properties of a SharePoint drive item for Teams file card attachments.

methods.name: resolveGraphChatId
methods.description: Resolves a Bot Framework conversation ID to a Graph API chat ID, handling non-Graph formats.

methods.name: getChatMembers
methods.description: Fetches members of a Teams chat for per-user sharing.

methods.name: createSharePointSharingLink
methods.description: Creates a sharing link for a SharePoint drive item, supporting organization-wide or per-user scope.

methods.name: uploadAndShareSharePoint
methods.description: Uploads a file to SharePoint and creates a sharing link, scoped to chat members or organization.
